note: Schema-compatibility placeholder. No ITLA dataset is public. Dataset classes are listed only because the Cabinet text names them; availability is 'not_available' until officially released. Nothing here is modelled or estimated.

institution.name: Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority (ITLA)
institution.form: Special Purpose Vehicle; National Apex Institution for transport and logistics research, planning, appraisal, monitoring and impact assessment

stated_mandate: Prepare a long-term National Transport Master Plan (horizon of ten years or more) across roads, railways, ports and shipping, civil aviation, inland waterways, coastal shipping, urban mobility and logistics.
Evaluate ministries' ~5-year sectoral plans and annual plans for consistency with the master plan.
Technical appraisal of Government infrastructure projects costing ₹500 crore or more (financial appraisal stays with existing mechanisms).
Build a National Transport Data Repository and run analytics such as freight-flow and origin–destination analysis.

dataset_classes.label: GSTN e-way bill flows
dataset_classes.planned_use: If released in aggregate, district-to-district goods flows could validate which industrial nodes actually ship through which gateways (SCCS import/export-gateway components).

dataset_classes.label: FASTag toll transactions
dataset_classes.planned_use: Corridor-level freight volumes and travel-time reliability for ICS road components.

dataset_classes.label: Vahan vehicle registry
dataset_classes.planned_use: Commercial-vehicle fleet density around industrial nodes.

dataset_classes.label: GPS-based fleet systems
dataset_classes.planned_use: Dwell times at gateways and last-mile bottlenecks (CGI evidence).

dataset_classes.label: Urban traffic management systems
dataset_classes.planned_use: Urban-edge congestion affecting nodes near cities (e.g. Sanand–Ahmedabad).

dataset_classes.label: Freight-flow / origin–destination analytics
dataset_classes.planned_use: The single most valuable input for SCCS and IOS; would let the Atlas replace distance proxies with observed flows.

integration_points: infrastructure-projects.json carries itla_appraisal_tier (≥ ₹500 cr GoI project) so ITLA appraisals can attach to existing project records.
ScoreComponentInput can switch from distance-band derivation to observed-flow derivation without changing pages.
Source registry already holds the Cabinet record (src:pmindia-itla-2026).
